question: What attitudes toward mantra and guru must always be avoided?
premises: Mantra must not be reduced to mere letters
Disbelief in the guru is faulted
These faults must be avoided always
inference: One must always avoid seeing mantra as mere letters and disbelieving the guru.
uncertainties: Verse lists faults without explicit verb; prohibition is inferred from context
plain_english: One must always avoid regarding the mantra as mere letters and having disbelief in the guru.
